facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, through a local bank; foreign clients may pay in foreign currency.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: keep foreign-currency accounts locally; accounts abroad need central bank approval.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Selcom Pesa lets small businesses receive local QR payments instantly.
facts.L1_registration: Get a TIN within 15 days of starting, then a business licence.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from TRA, online with your NIN, sometimes within 24 hours.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed; presumptive 4% up to TZS 200m, but professionals excluded.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT above TZS 200m; licensed professionals register regardless; exports zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Register with the Personal Data Protection Commission before processing personal data.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel within 7 days if they haven't benefited materially.
facts.L7_incentives: First-year tax holiday for new businesses, and 4% presumptive tax.

watch_out.text: Keeping a bank account abroad needs the central bank Governor's approval.
Invoice local clients in TZS; foreign currency only for genuine foreign clients.
Not registering with the data commission can bring fines up to TZS 5m.
